whatIs: It's a guide in Spanish for preparing for software technical interviews, published as a repository and as a website. It organizes by topic links to third-party articles, repositories and courses on principles like SOLID and Clean Code, best practices by language and framework, algorithms and data structures, design patterns, system design, databases, Git, CI/CD and containers, and adds lists of frontend and backend interview questions.
It's a good fit as a review map before an interview or to find out which topics you still need to study.
uses: Reviewing design patterns and SOLID principles before a technical interview.
Finding lists of frontend and backend interview questions to practice.
Putting together a study plan for algorithms and data structures.
caveats: Rather than explaining each topic, it collects links to external resources, so quality depends on each source.
Many of the linked resources are in English.
It doesn't replace practicing coding problems on an algorithms platform.
pricingNote: Open source under the MIT license.
idealFor: Developers preparing for technical interviews who study in Spanish.
